summary: Iteration 2 backend smoke test for POS multi-date seed + new inventory features (opening stock, purchase invoices with batches, expiring report, FIFO checkout, POS auto-checkout).
passed: Auth: owner + manager login return tokens.
Incentives 2026-06-28: jahangir service_revenue=16010 and daily_bonus=700 (₹15,000–17,999 tier) — matches spec exactly.
POS auto-checkout: /api/inventory/checkouts returns 28 rows with source='pos', notes 'POS auto-checkout · invoice <num>', and invoice_number field populated.
Quality failures: GET /api/pos/quality-failures returns 6 rows (matches spec).
Inventory SKUs: GET /api/inventory/skus returns 21 SKUs each with 'batches' array containing id/qty/location/expiry_date/unit_cost.
Owner-only SKU create: POST /api/inventory/skus with opening_store_qty=5, opening_floor_qty=2, opening_expiry=2026-09-01 succeeds; manager blocked with HTTP 403.
Purchase invoices: existing INV-001 lists via GET /api/inventory/purchase-invoices with total=5000, correct line for SKU with expiry 2026-08-15 (booked earlier); store batch appears in expiring list.

Expiring batches: GET /api/inventory/expiring?days=90 returns 3 rows with days_left + recommendation; none <30d today (2026-07-01), so no RETURN_TO_VENDOR case exercised but no incorrect recommendations either.
FIFO manual checkout: POST /api/inventory/checkout moved stock from store to floor (moved=2) using batches by expiry ordering.
Owner dashboard: staff_count=12, sku_count=22, working_capital=228419.45 — coherent.

failed.issue: Endpoint requires additional required fields 'amount' and 'breakdown'. Review spec said body={staff_id, payout_date} should succeed; server returns 422 pydantic 'missing' for amount+breakdown.

Endpoint requires 'invoice_number', 'vendor', 'invoice_date' in addition to 'lines'. Review spec said body=lines only should work. Endpoint itself works correctly when full body is provided (confirmed via existing INV-001 total=5000).

Not directly re-tested by uploading same CSV; verified only via dates list unchanged after startup seed. Auto-seed itself is idempotent (3 dates present, no duplicates). Full re-upload assertion of skipped_duplicates>0 & imported=0 not executed to avoid mutating state.

failed.area: FIFO ordering when expiry is None
failed.issue: Batches with expiry_date=None appear to sort as earliest (consumed first) during store->floor move. Depending on intended semantics, None expiries may need to sort last. Non-blocking.
failed.evidence: Store-to-floor move drew from (None) batch before (2026-08-15) batch.

action_items: Confirm intended request schema for POST /api/payouts/confirm — either accept {staff_id, payout_date} only (compute amount/breakdown server-side) or update review spec.
Confirm intended request schema for POST /api/inventory/purchase-invoice — same alignment question.
Consider adding a lightweight round-trip test that re-POSTs a stored CSV to /api/pos/upload to verify skipped_duplicates > 0 and imported == 0 explicitly.
Decide FIFO tiebreaker for batches with null expiry (sort last vs first).
